newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat ends up in nearbys on USDA stocks tally.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat ends up in nearbys on USDA stocks tally.

text.p: CBOT wheat closed mixed with nearby contracts higher on bullish input from a USDA quarterly stocks report, traders said.
"The report was bullish for wheat," said Vic Lespinasse of Dean Witter Reynolds.

USDA's stocks report, released at 0730 CDT Monday, showed the U.S. wheat supply as of September 1 at 1.724 billion bushels. That tally was below an average of analysts' estimates for 1.767 billion bushels.
Commercial bull spreading and late fund buying plus late short covering led the December contract higher.
Continental Grain bull spread three million bushels of December/March and also did an inter market spread of two million bushels of December wheat/December corn, the traders said.
Refco Inc was a late purchaser of 3.5 million bushels of December, they said.
Wheat futures volume was estimated at 15,000 contracts, up from 10,496 Friday, according to the CBOT.
Wheat futures closed 4-1/2 cents per bushel higher to 5-1/4 lower, with December up 4-1/2 at $4.36. March closed 1/2 higher at $4.22-1/2.
In wheat options, Refco Inc bought 400 December, $4.00 puts at 3-3/8 to four cents, the traders said.
Wheat options volume was estimated at 7,500 contracts, up from 6,609 Friday.
